description: Shared Renovate policy for every ralton-dev and bralton repo.
A repo opts in with `"extends": ["github>ralton-dev/.github"]` and keeps only its own grouping rules and dashboard title.

packageRules.description: Routine minor, patch, digest and pin updates go in one weekly PR that merges itself once CI is green.
A minor bump of a 0.x package may be breaking, so it gets its own PR and a manual merge, like a major.

Major updates open as PRs without dashboard approval, and wait for a manual merge. No groupName here: this rule runs after the presets above, and clearing the group would undo the Node.js runtime grouping.
